style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: overhead flat-lay photograph of paper documents on a plain desk surface, top-down 90-degree view, a stack of regulatory notices and bills slightly out of alignment to look handled, illegibly cropped text, muted paper tones, even diffused daylight, blank pages
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, watermarks, people, hands, faces, lightbulb, gavel, scales of justice
rationale: The story revolves around a significant rate hike in an insurance pool—a regulatory and contractual change that hits homeowners via a rate notice. A flatlay of paper documents captures the administrative reality of this change, emphasizing the bill and the mandated fixes without relying on abstract metaphors.
cue: the wildfire part of the bill
subject: a stack of muted, slightly misaligned regulatory paper documents
alt_text: Overhead view of slightly misaligned, blank regulatory paper documents on a plain desk.
caption: California homeowners face a steep rate hike unless they harden their homes to earn a discount.
title: FAIR Plan Rate Notice Documents

input.prompt:
overhead flat-lay photograph of paper documents on a plain desk surface, top-down 90-degree view, a stack of regulatory notices and bills slightly out of alignment to look handled, illegibly cropped text, muted paper tones, even diffused daylight, blank pages
